title: Evangelical Escape
author: JamesAggression
description: As you step in the shoes of Jason Black, a music talent scout, you find yourself lost in the backwoods of Mississippi, while taking a trip to the south to see a new up and coming act. You are brought into a Evangelical Church, and you must escape before they try and convert you. The writing style is a little bit humorous, and a little dry. The technical aspects of the game are a little simple as this is my first attempt at a twine game, this was to feel out how it plays. Hope you enjoy a first draft, of something that could be a comical adventure.
